$description: Layout tokens for Carbon Design System — spacing, container, icon size, fluid spacing, size, border-radius, and deprecated layout scale.

spacing.$description: Spacing scale based on the 8px mini-unit grid.

spacing-01.$description: Spacing token — 2px. Use for the smallest internal padding or gaps between tightly-packed elements.

spacing-02.$description: Spacing token — 4px. Use for compact padding within dense components.

spacing-03.$description: Spacing token — 8px. Default small spacing unit for inset padding and icon gaps.

spacing-04.$description: Spacing token — 12px. Use for comfortable inset padding in small components.

spacing-05.$description: Spacing token — 16px. Standard spacing unit; use for typical component padding and gutters.

spacing-06.$description: Spacing token — 24px. Use for section padding and medium gaps between components.

spacing-07.$description: Spacing token — 32px. Use for group separation and larger layout gaps.

spacing-08.$description: Spacing token — 40px. Use for generous padding between distinct sections.

spacing-09.$description: Spacing token — 48px. Use for large vertical rhythm and section separation.

spacing-10.$description: Spacing token — 64px. Use for major page section gaps.

spacing-11.$description: Spacing token — 80px. Use for hero and large feature-area spacing.

spacing-12.$description: Spacing token — 96px. Use for very large layout separations.

spacing-13.$description: Spacing token — 160px. Use for the largest page-level spacing needs.

fluid-spacing-01.$description: Fluid spacing token — 0. Use when no fluid spacing is required.

fluid-spacing-02.$description: Fluid spacing token — 2vw. Use for viewport-proportional small spacing in fluid layouts.

fluid-spacing-03.$description: Fluid spacing token — 5vw. Use for medium fluid spacing that scales with the viewport.

fluid-spacing-04.$description: Fluid spacing token — 10vw. Use for large fluid spacing in full-bleed or hero sections.

container-01.$description: Container height token — 24px. Minimum interactive target height for compact UI elements.

container-02.$description: Container height token — 32px. Small interactive element height.

container-03.$description: Container height token — 40px. Default interactive element height.

container-04.$description: Container height token — 48px. Large interactive element height.

container-05.$description: Container height token — 64px. Extra-large interactive element height.

size-xs.$description: Component size token — XSmall, 24px. Use for the smallest component variant.

size-md.$description: Component size token — Medium, 40px. Default component size.

icon-size-01.$description: Icon size token — 16px. Standard icon size for inline and UI icons.

icon-size-02.$description: Icon size token — 20px. Use for slightly larger icons that need more visual weight.

border-radius.$description: Border radius tokens for component rounding.

border-radius-00.$description: Border radius token — 0. No rounding; use for sharp-cornered elements.

border-radius-02.$description: Border radius token — 2px. Subtle rounding for small components like tags and badges.

border-radius-04.$description: Border radius token — 4px. Default rounding for inputs, cards, and general components.

border-radius-08.$description: Border radius token — 8px. Moderate rounding for panels, modals, and containers.

border-radius-16.$description: Border radius token — 16px. Strong rounding for large cards or featured containers.

border-radius-24.$description: Border radius token — 24px. Very rounded corners for pill-adjacent components.

border-radius-max.$description: Border radius token — pill/fully rounded. Use for pill buttons, chips, and circular elements.

layout.$description: Deprecated layout scale tokens. Replaced by the spacing scale — do not use in new work.

layout-01.$description: Deprecated layout token — 16px. Replaced by spacing scale. Do not use in new work.

layout-02.$description: Deprecated layout token — 24px. Replaced by spacing scale. Do not use in new work.

layout-03.$description: Deprecated layout token — 32px. Replaced by spacing scale. Do not use in new work.

layout-04.$description: Deprecated layout token — 48px. Replaced by spacing scale. Do not use in new work.

layout-05.$description: Deprecated layout token — 64px. Replaced by spacing scale. Do not use in new work.

layout-06.$description: Deprecated layout token — 96px. Replaced by spacing scale. Do not use in new work.

layout-07.$description: Deprecated layout token — 160px. Replaced by spacing scale. Do not use in new work.
